scope: Original read-only source analysis for a pin-owning external-input, interrupt-free VC polling driver. No main-tree writes, harnesses, tests, or silicon measurements performed.
route_policy: Positive input accepts channel0..3, negative external input only channel0..1. The mux number is not a GPIO alternate-function number; use GPIOx_ANALOG.PINy=1.
Intersect these source-qualified routes with the selected package bonded-pin list. L010 SOP16 specifically lacks PB2/PB3/PB4.
L012 PB0 is both VC1_CH3 and VC3_CH3; PB1 is both VC2_CH3 and VC4_CH3. Hold unique pin ownership rather than duplicating tokens.
Family-only chip records have no package metadata; do not infer physical bonding from family data.

common_polling_semantics.clock_enable: SYSCTRL_APBEN1.VC bit1; keyed register write with KEY0x5A5A in bits31:16. Enable once without resetting peer comparators.
common_polling_semantics.clock_reset: SYSCTRL_APBRST1.VC bit1; zero resets entire VC group, one releases. Never reset or gate off the shared group from per-instance construction/drop.
common_polling_semantics.gpio: Own both external pins, configure each for analog input without pulls/digital output. Preserve unrelated port bits.
common_polling_semantics.control: Initialize selected instance disabled. INP=0..3, INN=0..1; IE=0, WINDOW=0, POL=0, HYS configurable or0; RESP=0 low or1 high. FLTTIME=0, FLTCLK=1 (PCLK); disable all interrupt-trigger and blanking enables. L012 additionally CR2=0. Then EN=1.
common_polling_semantics.result: SR.FLTV bit1 is RO comparator output after digital filter; FLTTIME=0 selects no filter. With WINDOW=0/POL=0 and no active blanking, true means positive input exceeds negative input, subject to offset/hysteresis/settling. Equal/near-equal inputs are unspecified. No numeric voltage result or readiness bit exists.
common_polling_semantics.interrupt_flag: SR.INTF bit0 is RW0: zero clears; one has no effect. Polling output does not require reading or clearing interrupt flags.
common_polling_semantics.drop: Only disable the owned instance and release its pins. Do not modify divider, DAC, ADC/BGR, peer VC control, global VC reset/gate, or pin output AF.

electrical_caveats: Comparator maxima in these tables are characterization results, not production tested.

No startup maximum is supplied. A 0.5us delay is typical only, and no fixed constructor delay can honestly guarantee settling from these sources. Propagation maxima after input changes are not interchangeable with the missing startup maximum.
The register exposes no ready indicator. Expose current output with clear startup/input-settling caveats or require application-qualified settling; never claim a source-guaranteed ready state.
Input-voltage bounds are board obligations and cannot be verified by a pin-token API. General GPIO absolute margins are not valid comparator operating ranges.
shared_resource_hazards: All VCs in each family share the APBEN1.VC clock gate and APBRST1.VC reset.
L010/L011 VC1 and VC2 share VC_DIV. Changing VIN/DIV or EN affects both. L010 VIN0 selectsVDD, L011 selectsVDDA; VIN1 selectsVcore approximately1.6V. Divider output=supply*(1+DIV)/8, DIV0..7.

L010/L011 negative mux2 is internal BGR1.2V, enabled through ADC_CR.BGREN. The SDK enables ADC gate and sets shared BGREN for this route; external-only driver should not touch either. UM cites approximately30us startup, not a bound. L010 datasheet7.3.4 table7-7 printed32/PDF33 instead gives45us typical with no maximum; L011 datasheet7.3.4 printed37/PDF40 gives no startup bound.
L012 VC1/VC2 shareVC12REF; VC3/VC4 shareVC34REF. Negative mux2 is DAC_OUT1 forVC1/VC3 andDAC_OUT2 forVC2/VC4, not directBGR. Do not change DAC or either divider for external-only inputs.

L012 UM25.12.19 printed599/PDF625 states BGREN,ADCEN,TSEN,VC1/2/3/4 andOPA1/2 enables auto-startBGR and only software disable orPOR disables it;27.7.3 printed628/PDF654 explicitly says high-speedRESP auto-enablesBGR. Preserve sharedBGR and do not promise low speed never affectsBGR. Approximately30us BGR startup is not a maximum.

FLTCLK=0 withEN=1 may auto-startLSI even when no filtering is selected; choosingPCLK for no-filter polling avoids this documented unwanted clock/power dependency. L010UM4.7.2 printed68/PDF69;L011UM printed66/PDF67;L012UM printed46/PDF72.
Window mode combines multiple VC outputs; disable it for independent single-comparator polling. Blanking can force an output level temporarily; disable all trigger enables.

pac_review.matching: All external mux fields and CR0/CR1/CR2/SR bit positions and absolute addresses agree with exact SDK headers and manual after normalizing base origins. No required external-polling field-layout correction found.
pac_review.l010_l011_layout: PAC basesVC1=0x400000a4,VC2=0x400000b4 and offsetsCR0=0,CR1=4,SR=8 equal manual VC_BASE0x400000a0 with +4/+8/+12 plus16*(x-1).
pac_review.l012_layout: PAC basesVC1=0x40000084,VC2=0x40000094,VC3=0x40000184,VC4=0x40000194 and offsetsCR0=0,CR1=4,CR2=8,SR=12 equal manual bases0x40000080,0x40000090,0x40000180,0x40000190 with +4/+8/+12/+16. This is an origin difference, not an error.
pac_review.access_metadata: YAML supplies fields without encoding FLTV RO or INTF RW0 semantics. HAL should use onlyFLTV reads and avoid generic read-modify-write ofSR.
pac_review.l012_reset: ManualCR1 reset is0x10(PCLK), whereas L010/L011 manuals show0; YAML has no explicit register reset values. Explicitly writeFLTCLK=1 rather than depending on reset.
